title: Planned maintenance: NBN Tullamarine (VIC) network connection changes
current_summary: We have planned maintenance on our network at the Tullamarine (Victoria) NBN point of interconnect. It is scheduled from 12:00 am to 3:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 27 October 2026. During this window, NBN services connected through this point may be disrupted for up to 3 hours.

cause.reason: Planned maintenance to move services from legacy network connections to new ones at the Tullamarine NBN point of interconnect.

updates.content: We have scheduled planned maintenance at the Tullamarine (Victoria) NBN point of interconnect. We will be moving services from legacy network connections to new connections. The work is scheduled from 12:00 am to 3:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 27 October 2026. NBN services connected through this point may be disrupted for up to 3 hours during this window. We will share any changes to the schedule here.
